General education (Cal-GETC or CSU Northridge GE) and upper-division courses are also required to complete the bachelor's degree. Completion of all coursework listed in this agreement is not mandatory prior to admission. For CSU Northridge Undergraduate Admission Requirements, refer to Upper Division Transfer.
